duration.value: instantaneous DESCRIPTION You quickly slide between dimensions, teleporting a short but inaccurate distance. You may teleport up to 30 feet in any direction. You must be able to see your destination in order to teleport. However, when you arrive, you re-enter 1 square off target, as per the rules for thrown splash weapons. If this would place you in an occupied square, you instead arrive in the nearest safe location.
